messages:
Maya: Heads-up — CI perf spike immediately after driver bump 12.3.4 -> 12.3.5. Small-batch p50 for conv-heavy models up ~18% on A100s, reproduces locally. 
Sanjay: Ugh. Which kernel path shifted? Any evidence it picked a different cuDNN conv algo?
Maya: Profiling shows a different conv algorithm selection in cuDNN heuristics. KV-prefetch numbers also slightly worse but main delta is conv launch time.
Liam: Can you paste the perf snippet?
Maya: Sure — short trace from `perf-trace` run on nightly canary:
```
model: chat-6B-smallbatch
seq_len: 8
batch: 2
old driver 12.3.4: conv_forward time ~ 1.2 ms (algo 7)
new driver 12.3.5: conv_forward time ~ 1.42 ms (algo 14)
cuDNN: heuristic chose algo 14 instead of 7
```
Emma: algo 14 is a different FFT-ish path we've seen be worse on tiny batches. We blocked that in our autotune table previously via a threshold.
Sanjay: Did the autotune cache get invalidated during the rollout? Or is this entirely cuDNN heuristic change?
Maya: Both? Driver update changed workspace/query behavior so our autotuner scored algo 14 slightly higher at seq_len 8. Also noticed `cudnnGetConvolutionForwardAlgorithm` now returns different ranking order.
Liam: Can we force the autotune table to prefer 7 for smallbatch as a hotfix? That'd be a local revert of the scoring table rather than full rollback.
Emma: We can ship a patched autotune policy: set `priority:{seq<=16,batch<=4}: prefer_algo:7`. Low risk and quick.
Maya: CI still fails on main nightly because build picks driver 12.3.5 in CI images. This is blocking canary rollout for infra teams.
Sanjay: Steps for bisect: 1) repro locally on 12.3.5 2) confirm forcing algo 7 regresses back to baseline 3) try forcing `CUDNN_DEFAULT_ALGO=...` or autotune patch 4) if passes, ship autotune patch to canary image.
Maya: Did a quick test forcing algos — patch restores p50 within 2% of baseline.
DeployBot: Canary deploy aborted: perf-regression-check failed for service inference-gpu-canary.
InfraBot: CI image builder used base image `rwinf/gpu:2026-03-17-driver12.3.5` for nightly.
Liam: Sounds like a rollout blocker. Recommend: patch autotune policy, create a canary image with patched config and gated rollout, notify stakeholders. If patch doesn't hold, fallback is pinning CI images back to 12.3.4 and pausing GA rollout.
Emma: I'll draft the autotune patch and a short test plan. Will also add a regression unit that asserts algo selection for seq<=16 stays stable.
Sanjay: Add a follow-up TODO to contact NVIDIA support with the `cudnnGetConvolutionForwardAlgorithm` ordering change and attach the minimal repro.
Maya: Agreed. Marking this thread as a rollout blocker for the canary. I'll open the config PR and link to this thread. :warning:
Liam: thx. Keep infra in the loop — if we need to pin CI images, ping me and I'll coordinate rollback.
Emma: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/autotune/pulls/482 (wip)
Maya: Closing loop: patch validated on 3 different A100 variants, pushing canary image now. Will update once canary passes perf job.
